Sullivan and a separate Republican candidate with a very similar name (Dan L. Sullivan). I previously wrote about the issues raised by the two Dan Sullivans here . articles.summary: I've been watching the "available storage" bars on my various digital storage systems creep up over the last couple years, with a growing sense of dread. articles.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu addresses the United Nations General Assembly on Sept. 24, 2026 in New York City. Photo by Alexi J. Rosenfeld/Getty Images. It was the spring of 1986. President Ronald Reagan had just delivered a national address pleading with Congress to give $100 million in military aid to the Contras – a right-wing paramilitary group seeking to overthrow the socialist Nicaraguan government – whom he once called the moral equivalent of America’s founding fathers.
